text: In 2010 Culpeper County Public Schools received a parent complaint that Anne Frank's The Diary of a Young Girl contained “explicit material and homosexual themes”; the district kept the book in its library but changed the curriculum to use an earlier, less explicit version. Lebanon banned the diary for portraying Jews, Israel and Zionism favourably.
meta_description: Anne Frank's The Diary of a Young Girl: challenged in Culpeper County Public Schools in 2010 and banned in Lebanon for portraying Jews, Israel and Zionism favourably.
